title: SL-S4Wave: Self-Supervised Learning of Physiological Waveforms with Structured State Space Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.19888v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modeling long-sequence medical time series data, such as electrocardiograms (ECG), poses significant challenges due to high sampling rates, multichannel signal complexity, inherent noise, and limited labeled data. While recent self-supervised learning (SSL) methods, based on various encoder architectures such as convolutional neural networks, have been proposed to learn representations from unlabeled data, they often fall short in capturing long-range dependencies and noise-invariant features. Structured state space models (S4) excel at long-sequence modeling, but existing S4 architectures fail to capture the unique characteristics of multichannel physiological waveforms. In this work, we propose SL-S4Wave, a self-supervised learning framework that combines contrastive learning with a tailored encoder built on structured state space models. translated_title: SL-S4Wave：基于结构化状态空间模型的生理波形自监督学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.19888v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：对长序列医学时间序列数据（如心电图ECG）进行建模，面临着高采样率、多通道信号复杂性、固有噪声以及有限标注数据等重大挑战。尽管近年来基于卷积神经网络等各种编码器架构的自监督学习（SSL）方法已被提出用于从无标签数据中学习表示，但它们往往在捕捉长程依赖和噪声不变特征方面表现不足。结构化状态空间模型（S4）擅长长序列建模，但现有的S4架构未能捕捉多通道生理波形的独特特征。在本工作中，我们提出SL-S4Wave，一种自监督学习框架，将对比学习与基于结构化状态空间模型的定制编码器相结合。该编码器利用多尺度子核实现多层全局卷积，从而增强了长程依赖捕捉能力。
tldr: 提出了SL-S4Wave框架，通过结合对比学习和多尺度子核的S4编码器，有效捕捉多通道生理波形的长程依赖与噪声不变特征，解决了现有方法在长序列建模中的不足。
en_tdlr: The proposed SL-S4Wave framework combines contrastive learning with an S4 encoder using multiscale subkernels to effectively capture long-range dependencies and noise-invariant features in multichannel physiological waveforms, addressing limitations of existing methods in long-sequence modeling.
